mutants.name: always-first-source-line
mutants.rationale: All existing diagnostic inputs are one line; a first-line-only fix must fail on later-line errors.

alternatives.name: indented-erlang-diagnostic
alternatives.rationale: Adds two spaces to continuation lines while retaining exception class, reason, source, location and the original first-line prefix. A readable equivalent diagnostic should not be rejected solely for layout. Original snapshot acceptance should fail; semantic replacement and new checks should pass.

replacements.after:
output = format_result({:error, kind, error, stacktrace}, :elixir)
      Map.update!(output, :message, &String.replace(&1, "\n", "\n  "))
